topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The idea of the fence unsettles me. It looms large in my thoughts, a barrier rising not just between plots of land but between lives that have, until now, blended effortlessly at the edges. I find myself pacing the length of my backyard, the gentle hum of the mower from across the fence doing little to soothe my agitation. It seems such a small request, a request to discuss it, to perhaps find a compromise. Yet, the uncertainty of it all, the unknown, presses heavily on my chest. What will change once the posts are set and the fence stands? Will the easy camaraderie remain, or will we all be encased in our own, neatly defined spaces?
